mapper.select: SELECT place_id, place_type, name, route_name, direction, latitude, longitude, parking_spaces FROM rest_places WHERE active = TRUE AND latitude IS NOT NULL AND longitude IS NOT NULL
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO rest_places ( place_type, source_key, name, route_name, direction, latitude, longitude, address, parking_spaces, active, synced_at ) VALUES ( #{row.placeType}, #{row.sourceKey}, #{row.name}, #{row.routeName,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{row.direction,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{row.latitude,jdbcType=DOUBLE}, #{row.longitude,jdbcType=DOUBLE}, #{row.address,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{row.parkingSpaces,jdbcType=INTEGER}, TRUE, #{syncedAt} ) ON CONFLICT (place_type, source_key) DO UPDATE SET name = EXCLUDED.name, route_name = EXCLUDED.route_name, direction = EXCLUDED.direction, latitude = EXCLUDED.latitude, longitude = EXCLUDED.longitude, address = EXCLUDED.address, parking_spaces = EXCLUDED.parking_spaces, active = TRUE, synced_at = EXCLUDED.synced_at
